create_trainer_from_config: create a Trainer instance from TrainerSection and RegimeSection config using _TrainerFactory
create_validator_from_config: create a StandardValidator or NOOP_VALIDATOR from config sections using _ValidatorFactory
create_fp16_loss_scaler: create a Float16LossScaler for FP16 training with automatic scale window calculation
create_huggingface_exporter: create a HuggingFaceExporter for model conversion using _HuggingFaceExporterFactory
get_score_metric_descriptor: get the MetricDescriptor for the configured score metric using _MaybeScoreMetricProvider
